name: atlas-ai
description: A private knowledge copilot: upload your documents, ask questions, and get streamed answers with citations you can check.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w @atlas/api" "npm run dev -w @atlas/worker" "npm run dev -w @atlas/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @atlas/api && npm run build -w @atlas/worker && npm run build -w @atlas/web
